code:
import requests, re, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
h={"User-Agent":"curation-agent/1.0","Accept":"application/json"}

ACC={"MDH1 (mitochondrial)":"P17505","MDH2 (cytosolic)":"P22133","MDH3 (peroxisomal)":"P32419"}
seqs={}
for name,acc in ACC.items():
    j=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",headers=h,timeout=60).json()
    seqs[name]=j['sequence']['value']
    loc=[sl['location']['value'] for c in j.get('comments',[]) if c['commentType']=='SUBCELLULAR LOCATION' for sl in c['subcellularLocations']]
    feats=[(f['type'],f['location']['start']['value'],f['location']['end']['value'],f.get('description')) for f in j.get('features',[]) if f['type'] in ('Transit peptide','Motif','Signal')]
    print(f"{name} ({acc}) len={len(seqs[name])} UniProt_SL={loc}")
    print("   features:", feats)
    print("   N-term30:", seqs[name][:30])
    print("   C-term10:", seqs[name][-10:])
    print()

# ---------- Targeting-signal tests ----------
PTS1 = re.compile(r"[SAC][KRH][LMI]$")                 # canonical PTS1 consensus
PTS2 = re.compile(r"R[LVIQ].{2}[LVIHQ][LSGAK][HQ]")    # canonical PTS2 nonapeptide core
posi = set("KR"); nega = set("DE")
# Kyte-Doolittle for amphipathicity proxy
KD = dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-0.9,-0.4,-0.8,-0.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))

def mito_presequence_score(s, n=25):
    """Mitochondrial matrix presequences: net positive, Arg-rich, no acidic residues, amphipathic helix."""
    w=s[:n]
    npos=sum(c in posi for c in w); nneg=sum(c in nega for c in w)
    nR=w.count("R"); nS=w.count("S")+w.count("T")
    # moment of hydrophobicity at 100 deg (alpha helix) over first n residues
    ang=np.deg2rad(100*np.arange(len(w)))
    hvals=np.array([KD.get(c,0) for c in w])
    mu=np.sqrt((hvals*np.cos(ang)).sum()**2+(hvals*np.sin(ang)).sum()**2)/len(w)
    return dict(net_charge=npos-nneg, n_Arg=nR, n_acidic=nneg, n_SerThr=nS, hydrophobic_moment=round(float(mu),3))

def nls_hits(s):
    out=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"K[KR][KR][KR]", s): out.append(("classical monopartite pat4", m.start()+1, m.group()))
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?=([KR]{2}.{9,12}[KR]{3,5}))", s): out.append(("bipartite", m.start()+1, m.group(1)))
    return out

rows=[]
for name,s in seqs.items():
    d=mito_presequence_score(s)
    rows.append(dict(protein=name, length=len(s), C_term3=s[-3:],
        PTS1_match=bool(PTS1.search(s)), PTS2_match=bool(PTS2.search(s[:40])),
        UniProt_transit_peptide = (name.startswith("MDH1")),
        n_NLS_motifs=len(nls_hits(s)), **d))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print("="*110); print("TARGETING SIGNAL COMPARISON, yeast MDH isozymes"); print("="*110)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nNLS motif hits per protein:")
for name,s in seqs.items(): print(" ", name, nls_hits(s) or "none")

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.2))
lab=[n.split()[0] for n in df.protein]
colors=["#4C78A8","#F58518","#54A24B"]
axes[0].bar(lab, df.net_charge, color=colors)
axes[0].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.8); axes[0].set_title("Net charge of N-terminal 25 residues")
axes[0].set_ylabel("(K+R) - (D+E)")
axes[1].bar(lab, df.n_acidic, color=colors)
axes[1].set_title("Acidic residues in N-terminal 25")
axes[1].set_ylabel("count of D+E")
axes[2].bar(lab, [1 if x else 0 for x in df.PTS1_match], color=colors)
axes[2].set_ylim(0,1.3); axes[2].set_yticks([0,1]); axes[2].set_yticklabels(["absent","present"])
axes[2].set_title("C-terminal PTS1 consensus [SAC][KRH][LMI]")
for ax,(i,r) in zip(axes, df.iterrows()): pass
for i,r in df.iterrows():
    axes[2].text(i, 0.05, r.C_term3, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9, color="white", fontweight="bold")
fig.suptitle("Mdh2 has no mitochondrial presequence and no PTS1, unlike Mdh1 and Mdh3", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
